name: WordPress MCP Adapter
description: Exposes WordPress Abilities API functions as MCP tools, resources, and prompts, so agents can work with a WordPress site over HTTP or WP-CLI STDIO.

skills.name: Ability To MCP Conversion
skills.description: Turns registered WordPress abilities into MCP tools, resources, and prompts, keeping each ability private until marked public.

skills.name: Default Server Meta-Tools
skills.description: Lets agents discover, inspect, and execute public abilities through three meta-tools on the default MCP server endpoint.

skills.name: WP-CLI STDIO Server
skills.description: Serves an MCP server over STDIO with wp mcp-adapter serve, running as a chosen WordPress user for permission checks.

skills.name: Transport Permissions
skills.description: Applies per-server authentication callbacks and per-ability capability checks, defaulting to logged-in users only.
